in_marathi.name: Ameyansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's endless gift
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ameyansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ameyansh is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ameya’ (which means ‘limitless’ or ‘inexhaustible’) and ‘Ansh’ (which means ‘a part of’ or ‘a manifestation of’). The name signifies a divine being who is the embodiment of limitless blessings or an endless gift from God.
